notes: Teacher app 1.20.5. Joining a school with the code now puts you on staff immediately: your name, role and classes are created as you scan, so marks entry, the class register, reports and duty work at once. No waiting for a role to be assigned. Pulling the school setup no longer removes you from staff. The teacher app also runs on a laptop: the same marks entry, attendance and timetable, installed with its own setup file, handing the console the same bundle files as a phone.
